sections.heading: Insulated Glass Unit Replacement and Seal Failure Repair
sections.body: One of the most common window problems we see in Leesburg properties is foggy or hazy glass caused by failed seals on insulated glass units. When the seal between the two panes of a double- or triple-pane window breaks down, moisture enters the air space and creates condensation that cannot be wiped away. This not only affects visibility but also reduces the window's insulating performance. Our team can replace the insulated glass unit itself in many cases, restoring clarity and thermal performance without requiring a full window replacement. This approach saves time and money for both commercial and residential clients. We stock a range of glass thicknesses and unit configurations to match existing window frames accurately, ensuring a clean finish that blends seamlessly with the surrounding glazing.
